name: Stack Inbound
idea: Four teammates stand side by side, then everyone sprints a different way at once.
why: Each defender can only follow one player. When everyone breaks at the same time, somebody gets lost, and the player diving to the hoop is often wide open.
tryit: Practice the breaks with no defense first, so everyone knows their own direction. Inbounder: slap the ball to start, then look at the hoop first.

frames.say: {1} passes the ball in from behind the baseline. Everyone else lines up side by side at the free-throw line, in a *stack*.
*Go!* Everyone breaks a different way: {3} to the corner, {2} to the wing, and {4} back to the top.
{X5} runs out to help on {3}, so {5} turns and dives to the hoop.
Layup! When everyone breaks at once, the defense can't follow them all.
